name: G. K. P. Printing & Packaging Limited

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 21%
news.body: After last week's 21% share price gain to ₹6.39, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 19.7x. Average trailing P/E is 17x in the Packaging industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 51% over the past three years.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.05 (vs ₹0.10 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.05 (down from ₹0.10 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹72.0m (down 15% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.18m (down 46% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.6% (down from 2.6% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 6% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 26% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.title: G. K. P. Printing & Packaging Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 12, 2026
news.body: G. K. P. Printing & Packaging Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 12, 2026

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Additional Independent Non-Executive Director Harmesh Trivedi was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2023. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
